files.title: File:Benedict’s Block, Herrick Avenue and Main Street, Wellington, OH - 54431361877.jpg
files.author: w_lemay
files.caption: Built in 1873, this Italianate-style building was built for the Benedict family, and features a red brick exterior, roman arched bays with two-over-four and one-over-one windows, a simple cornice, and a modified first floor facade.  The building is a contributing structure in the Wellington Center Historic District, listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1974, and the Wellington Historic District, listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1979.
